children: On October 23, 2026, Innventure received notice that its stock had failed to meet Nasdaq's $1.00 minimum bid price requirement for 30 consecutive business days, under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5450(a)(1). The company has until April 21, 2027, to regain compliance by meeting the requirement for at least 10 consecutive business days; the notice does not immediately affect its listing, and a further 180-day period may be available if it meets other criteria and seeks a transfer to the Nasdaq Capital Market.
